title: Titanium Countersunk Screw (ISO 10642)
function: Countersunk flat head screw for flush mounting
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is specified for Titanium Countersunk Screw (ISO 10642) where the combination of high strength (830 MPa yield), low weight (4.43 g/cm³), and atmospheric corrosion immunity justifies the material upgrade from carbon or stainless steel. The alpha-beta microstructure is readily machinable at 30-50 SFM with carbide tooling and produces a stable oxide that requires no painting or plating in indoor/outdoor service — ideal for Countersunk flat head screw for flush mounting. This rationale is driven by countersunk flat head screw for flush mounting and specific design requirements.
process: CNC turning and boring for fastener geometry
surfaceTreatment: Passivation per ASTM B600 followed by hot DI water rinse 70C minimum to prevent flash rust on finished surfaces — tailored for countersunk flat head application
commonFailures: Surface contamination requiring acid passivation — critical for countersunk flat head performance

faq.q: What standard dimensional tolerances apply to Titanium Countersunk Screw (ISO 10642)?
faq.a: Titanium Countersunk Screw (ISO 10642) is manufactured to ISO 2768-m medium tolerances (±0.1 mm for basic dimensions up to 30 mm, ±0.2 mm for 30-120 mm). Functional mating surfaces can be held to ±0.025 mm with Ra 0.8 µm surface finish. For countersunk flat head, specific tolerance classes can be quoted based on functional requirements.

Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Countersunk Screw (ISO 10642)?
faq.a: Each Titanium Countersunk Screw (ISO 10642) shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for countersunk flat head.
